prose: A developer investigation shows Claude Code's new AGENTS.md support silently depends on a server-side feature flag: the loader ships as a built-in plugin whose availability asks a remote flag (tengu_agents_md_mod) with fallback false. With telemetry or non-essential traffic disabled (DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1), the flag never arrives and AGENTS.md is never read, even though reading a local markdown file needs no network. The post documents canary-word experiments across configurations and notes the first session in a new configuration only fetches the flag while the second uses it.
highlights: Claude Code 2.1.277's AGENTS.md loading is gated on a remote feature flag, not just file presence.
Verified with canary-word tests; tracked in issue #95690 with the author's own measurements.
First session in a new config only fetches the flag; the second session uses it.
